evidence: Requirement -> criterion map built from instruction.md and the six notes against 3 gate, 38 functional, 6 polish and 3 visual criteria. Coverage is broad: every editor rule in ui.md (typing/join, navigation and intended column, graphemes, mouse selection, replace/paste undo, block indent, caret in view, long line, multi-caret on different and same lines, undo caret, find/replace incl. self-containing text, JS and HTML colouring, JS/HTML format, format error, focus return, undo/redo availability, unsaved marker, 390 px), the run/stop/last-good/time-limit/supersede rules, save/restart/stale save/draft kept/history restore/live library/newer-revision notice, preview isolation and dynamic-code refusal each map to at least one criterion. Gaps found (every gap reported): (G1, basis of the Fail) behaviour.md:5 states 'After it settles, a later user interaction in the preview starts a fresh five-second budget for its own callbacks.' No criterion grades it: tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:258 cw_time_limit_recovery only runs an endless loop in the source and a self-rescheduling timer started by Run; judge.toml:213 cw_html_preview and :249 cw_last_good_recovery click a preview button but never test a budget for the work that click starts. The golden implements the rule (solution/app/src/runtime.ts:269-280 and :400), so it is a real, costly behaviour with zero reward mass. (G2) ui.md:9 'Undo and Redo also work from visible controls and normal keyboard shortcuts': no criterion requires the keyboard shortcut; functional criteria say only 'Undo'/'Redo' (e.g. judge.toml:123), and polish cw_focus_returns_to_code and cw_undo_redo_availability use the visible controls. (G3) security.md:3 'must not be able to make network requests from the preview, including to this app's own routes': judge.toml:285 cw_preview_isolation probes only a fetch of the app's own health address; requests to any other host, and non-fetch channels, are ungraded. (G4) behaviour.md:1 'Show console output in the order it was written': only marker-above-reason is checked (judge.toml:240); the order of two or more authored console lines is never checked. (G5, minor, within one flow) behaviour.md:7 names intervals and Promise callbacks pending after Stop; only a timer is exercised (judge.toml:267). Lenient but not a gap: live library 'within about five seconds' is graded with a ten-second window. Runtime contract items in integration.md (entry, port, health, DB_PATH) are exercised by test.sh and the restart criterion. Raw evidence is scripted golden behaviour only; no configured judge run exists, so nothing here is measured against a real judge.
counterexample: Broken app that loses no credit: it enforces the five-second budget only for work started by Run. After the run settles, a preview button whose handler starts a self-rescheduling timer or an endless loop runs without any limit, the preview and console keep changing indefinitely (or the page hangs) and no time-limit reason or last-good restore ever appears. Every criterion still passes, because cw_time_limit_recovery only uses Run-started work. Second broken app (G3): a sandboxed opaque-origin preview with no network block; a plain fetch of the app's own health address fails on CORS so cw_preview_isolation passes, while fetch to any CORS-enabled public host succeeds from user-entered code. Third (G2): an editor with Undo/Redo buttons and no Ctrl/Cmd+Z handling can pass when the judge uses the buttons.
suggested_fix: Either add one functional criterion (or a leg in cw_time_limit_recovery) where, after a run has settled, a click in the preview starts a self-rescheduling timer and the app must end it with a visible time-limit reason within about ten seconds and stay usable, with a short click-started timer as the working control; or remove the interaction-budget sentence from behaviour.md and the golden together. For the smaller gaps: say 'with the usual keyboard shortcut' for Undo and Redo in one existing undo criterion, add an external public-host fetch probe to cw_preview_isolation, and add two ordered console lines to one existing run criterion. Weigh any added browser work against the measured judge budget before freezing.
